description: List current Frankfurter v1 currency codes and names with as_of, the latest served rate date. include_retired=true adds historical and statutory euro legacy codes absent from the current set, each marked retired=true. Statutory rows include their euro adoption date and fixed units per EUR. Optional official ECB start_date/end_date are outer market coverage bounds. Metadata outages are disclosed without failing current discovery. Use this to disambiguate dollars (USD vs AUD vs CAD).

include_retired.description: Include historical codes absent from current v1 discovery, marked retired=true; default false. Optional official ECB coverage dates are outer bounds and may contain gaps.

name: fx_list_currencies

as_of.description: Latest served daily rate date for this current-discovery list; historical availability is checked against historical data.

currencies.description: All supported currencies, sorted alphabetically by code.

adoption_date.description: Date the statutory factor took effect (YYYY-MM-DD).

code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY).

end_date.description: Last covered date in optional official ECB metadata; retired marks retirement, not this date.

retired.description: True only for a historical code include_retired added because it is absent from current v1 discovery; false for every current code.

start_date.description: First covered date in optional official ECB metadata; outer bound, not uninterrupted availability.

units_per_eur.description: Irrevocable legacy currency units per EUR.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fixed_rate_source.description: Legislation setting the statutory factors shown.

notice.description: Discloses unavailable optional coverage metadata or incomplete coverage dates.

source.description: Always "Frankfurter v1" — the upstream data provider.

title: Fx List Currencies
